Owner's requirement: app updates must not live in Settings. In the top bar (`components/app-shell.tsx`, next to Search, Ask and the "Needs attention" bell — both desktop and mobile headers) show an "Update" pill ONLY when an update is available; when there is none, show nothing. Remove the "App updates" section and nav entry from `app/settings/page.tsx` (`app/settings/app-update.tsx`, `app-update-actions.ts`) — move/reuse that logic, don't duplicate it.

It should download directly from the pill.
- Source installation (Docker/npm): no download is possible. Check the latest published GitHub release of indkhan/Moneo against the running version (cache the result, check at most a few times a day server-side, fail silently into "no pill" — but the failure must be named per the lint rule about ignored failures; no client setTimeout/setInterval — use `usePolling`/`useNow`/`useTimeout`). Clicking the pill shows the new version, release notes link, and the commands to update: `git pull` then `npm run setup` (and restart `npm run dev` / their server). Make sure this outside call is acceptable under the local-first rule: it sends no personal data (no identifying User-Agent beyond a generic one); add a line in README describing this check, and if AGENTS.md's local-first list needs updating, propose it in the PR body rather than editing silently.
- Must not slow first paint: the pill loads after the shell, without layout shift. Measure Home and Settings speed before/after (skill `measure-speed`).
- Mock GitHub and electron-updater in tests; write tests only for real behaviour (version comparison, caching, no-update → no pill).
- Update FEATURES.md (`npm run feature-map`), README, palette commands if "check for updates" exists there.

Workflow: commit in steps, messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:bundle`, affected Playwright; desktop workflow runs in CI since you touch desktop if you do. mMoneo

Privacy notice

Last updated 7 November 2026

What Moneo is

Moneo is open-source personal finance software that you install and run on your own computer. There is no Moneo service, account or server run by the developer.

Your data stays with you

Everything Moneo stores (accounts, transactions, imported statements, plans, chats and settings) is kept in a database on the computer where you run it. The developer of Moneo receives none of it: no analytics, tracking, telemetry or copies of your data.

Services you choose to connect

Moneo only contacts outside services that you set up yourself, and only sends what each feature needs:

  • Bank connections go through Enable Banking and your bank, under the consent you give your bank. Moneo reads balances and booked transactions for the accounts you approve.
  • Scalable Capital, if connected, shares your holdings, cash and portfolio value through its read-only access.
  • AI features send your questions and the parts of your data you allow (in Settings → AI and your data) to the provider you set up: OpenAI, through your ChatGPT plan or API key; Anthropic, through your Claude plan; or OpenRouter.

Each of these services handles data under its own privacy policy.

Deleting your data

Settings → Reset all data empties your workspace and ends your bank connections. Removing Moneo's Docker volumes deletes the database entirely.

Contact

Questions or concerns: open an issue on GitHub.
